data.title: Son of ex-Maj Gen set fire to house, attacked rescuers before taking own life
data.description: The son of a retired Maj Gen took his own life after allegedly setting fire to his home and shooting at firefighters before police would discover a cache of military-grade weapons and explosives at his two-storey property in Bangkok’s Bang Phlat district on Friday morning.

data.title: Passengers evacuated from ANA plane in Okinawa after midair engine trouble
data.description: Passengers were evacuated from an All Nippon Airways plane at Naha Airport in Okinawa prefecture on Wednesday night after it encountered engine trouble midair and returned, the Japanese airline said.

data.title: Your weekly horoscope for Sept 25-Oct 1
data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationships from Guru by Bangkok Post 's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: Taylor Swift releases 'Encore' to her hit 'Showgirl' album
data.description: LOS ⁠ANGELES - Pop music ​superstar Taylor Swift released four new songs ​that she added to ‌her 2025 hit album The Life of a Showgirl including the single Patient Zero about a toxic relationship.

data.title: US miner KoBold bets on AI to gain edge in DR Congo mineral hunt
data.description: MANONO — Geologists from US mining company KoBold Metals are pushing deep into the Congolese bush, hoping a cutting-edge army of "explorers" directed by artificial intelligence (AI) will help give them an edge in the race for critical minerals.

data.title: India's 'Tree Father' plants for a greener future
data.description: NOIDA — With Delhi's choking haze hanging overhead, Peepal Baba presses a young tree into the earth, continuing a nearly half-century mission to restore India's vanishing green cover.

data.title: Cash for nature protection: hotelier's offer to Principe islanders
data.description: SANTO ANTONIO (SAO TOME AND PRINCIPE) — On the paradise island of Principe, a lush jungle haven in the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Guinea, a South African multimillionaire is offering locals a financial dividend to preserve the natural beauty on which his luxury tourism business depends.

data.title: 'Genius' Ohashi bids for third Asian Games gold after world record
data.description: TOKYO — Japanese teenager Shin Ohashi moved closer to a hat-trick of Asian Games breaststroke golds after qualifying for the 50m final on Friday, the morning after smashing the 200-metre world record.

data.title: Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026 Celebrates Regional Watch Culture
data.description: BANGKOK, September 22, 2026 – Siam Paragon, a globally recognised landmark and Global Luxury Destination for both Thai and international visitors, officially kicks off “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026”, bringing together more than 45 leading global watch brands, influential figures from the watch industry, collectors and watch enthusiasts from around the world to celebrate the art and culture of watchmaking.

data.title: At UN, Netanyahu defends Israel as delegates walk out
data.description: NEW YORK — Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu mounted a forceful defence of Israel's actions in the region at the United Nations (UN) on Thursday, seeking ​to counter growing international isolation ahead of elections he could lose, as dozens of delegates streamed out.

data.title: Internet disrupted in Ethiopia as conflict rages
data.description: ADDIS ABABA — The internet was disrupted in northern Ethiopia on Friday, online monitor Netblocks said, as conflict raged between the federal government and Tigray rebels, while Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) confirmed connection difficulties.

data.title: City Hall steps up flood fight in eastern Bangkok
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is focusing its flood-control efforts on the eastern part of the capital for the rest of the day and has warned city residents of rain throughout Friday.

data.title: Siam Piwat Group promises world-class experiences through partnership with iQIYI
data.description: Reinforcing Siam Piwat's Co-create & Collaboration to Win strategy, a historic MOU was signed with iQIYI, a leading global entertainment platform partner. The collaboration combines the strong capabilities of a “Global Destination” and a “Premium Entertainment Platform” to elevate the experience to a new dimension, seamlessly connecting the real and digital worlds.

data.title: A greener, more connected Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand, 24 September 2026 – Deloitte Thailand (‘Deloitte’), a leading professional services firm with multidisciplinary expertise, together with the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (‘BMA’), today announced the completion of an enhancement project at Lumpini Park, supporting the improvement of one of Bangkok’s most valued public spaces and reflecting Deloitte’s long-standing commitment to Thailand and its communities.

data.title: Court acquits Boss Paul, two others in 2.5m-baht money-laundering case
data.description: The Criminal Court has acquitted The iCon Group founder and CEO Warathaphon “Boss Paul” Waratyaworrakul, politician Samart Janechaijittawanich and his mother, Wilawan Phutthasamrit, of charges of colluding to launder 2.5 million baht from the direct-sales company.

data.title: Brazil candidates mount digital armies for fierce online campaign
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO — In a knife-edge election race, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and main rival Flavio Bolsonaro have deployed volunteer digital armies online to spread their messages and battle for voters.

data.title: ‘America’s Got Talent’ winner Nene to open for Avenged Sevenfold in Singapore
data.description: Nene Royal will rock Singapore next month when the Thai sensation opens for Avenged Sevenfold.

data.title: Rooted in respect, worn with style: How Thai flower garlands became the ultimate hair accessory
data.description: For generations, Thailand’s intricate floral garlands were crafted for sacred spaces—hung at spirit houses, offered at shrines, or given as tokens of respect and safe passage. Today, the fragrant phuang malai is moving from the altar onto women's heads.

data.title: Pope heads to France on first state visit in 18 years
data.description: ROME — Pope Leo XIV flies to France on Friday for the Vatican's first state visit to the European nation in 18 years, with artificial intelligence (AI) and young believers near the top of his agenda.

data.title: Pope Leo in France: the issues on the table
data.description: PARIS — Pope Leo XIV is to begin an official visit to France on Friday, with several thorny issues hanging over the trip, from clerical sexual abuse to the country's new assisted dying law.

data.title: Rebellious Afghan taxi drivers defy ban on music
data.description: KABUL — Taxi drivers in Afghanistan are turning on the tunes in their cars, defying a ban imposed by the Taliban government despite the fear of getting caught by morality police.
